The coefficients are the population projection targets, not fitted estimates from a training sample. Preserve the second-treatment event alone in this formula; a first-treatment weight enters a different projection. The logistic denominator is positive for finite predictors, while stronger overlap or integrability bounds remain separate. This algebraic pseudo-outcome does not on its own prove that its conditional expectation equals the true conditional mean under arbitrary simultaneous misspecification.
